name: ELS registered remote busy-turn event injector
target: registered remote eln TUI pane during graceful update-all
inputs: one remote TC TUI pane with exact id, PID, session and cwd
busy turn remains active for one tick, then shell completion and owner restart
registered SSH transport throws a timeout in the failure scenario
observations: parent and child call actual updateAllElsTabs; child calls runSeatControl
the remote pane row becomes updated only after shell completion and owner PID change with the same session and cwd
an unresponsive remote host yields failed host and pane rows with zero local migration
entryCommands: eln --test=<isolated-state> sim world run els --seed 33 --engine legacy
